{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A textured black silk-blend sheath dress with a high neck and long sleeves, falling to mid-calf length in a fluid silhouette.
Black velvet pointed-toe pumps with a moderate heel for added elegance without compromising comfort on the dance floor.
A silver geometric necklace featuring frosted crystal stones that catch the candlelight, paired with delicate pearl drop earrings and a small clutch with a metallic finish.

This outfit perfectly balances the smart dress code required for an upscale restaurant while embracing the festive spirit of a New Year's celebration. The rich black velvet fabric provides warmth against the frosty autumn weather outside, creating an elegant barrier from the cold. The silver accents introduce a touch of holiday sparkle that complements her warm skin tones and hair color without overwhelming the refined look."}
